Name: Vanilla Plus Professions (VPP - Profession Expansion)
Author: KeDili
Description:
[center][/center][center][/center][center][/center][center]﻿[img]https://imgur.com/bL5AsiY.png[/img]
[size=4][font=Arial][b]﻿
40 NEW professions![/b]

These are built to choose at level 15, there's 8 of them for each of the vanilla skills.
Details are in the Profession Details Article!

[b]10 NEW Combo Professions![/b]

These are special professions available ONLY at level 20; they can be chosen regardless of what you chose at level 15, and they're always a crossover of two different skills.

Details:[spoiler]
[b]Farming-Mining[/b][b]:[/b] This profession allows you to use the Geode Crusher to produce Gem Dusts out of minerals, which you can use in place of fertilizers (gem dusts are affected by Agronomist profession as well.) Which type of effect they give depends on their price and color. Requires achieving level 20 in Farming.
[b]Farming-Foraging:[/b] Fruit trees and giant crops are tappable. You can now tap any giant crop and fruit tree with any tapper. Every {fruit price / 20} days that the tapper isn't removed, it will yield either a custom item defined by the game data (goes only for custom giant crops and fruit tree) or a Fruit Syrup flavored with the crop or fruit of the giant crop/fruit tree. Requires achieving level 20 in Farming.

[b]Fishing-Farming:[/b] Full fish ponds will ask for quest items, just as they did while wanting to expand the population. If you bring the item to them, they'll give double items for the rest of the week. Requires achieving level 20 in Fishing.
[b]Fishing-Mining:[/b] Gems can be used as tackles. Every vanilla gem will act like a certain vanilla tackle when placed to the fishing rod. Requires achieving level 20 in Fishing.

[b]Foraging-Fishing:[/b] Every four days, a randomly-selected forage item will be able to summon fishing bubbles when tossed in the water. Requires achieving level 20 in Foraging.
[b]Foraging-Combat: [/b]Off-screen monsters can be tracked. Similar to the Tracker Profession in vanilla, when you choose this profession you'll be shown small and moving red arrows that points at monsters. Requires achieving level 20 in Foraging.

[b]Mining-Combat:[/b] Gain combat buffs for every 100 stones broken that day via pickaxe or bombs. Every 100 stones you break will grant you Defense and attack buffs. It doesn't matter whether they're destroyed by hand or bombs, but it will reset the next day. Requires achieving level 20 in Mining.
[b]Mining-Foraging[/b][b]:[/b] Increased possibility for Mushroom level spawn. In vanilla, there are mushroom levels which spawn in the Mine, below level 80, has colorful lights on the walls and a lot of mushrooms. The chance for their appaearance is now at %15, while in vanilla this is %0.8. Requires achieving level 20 in Mining.

[b]Combat-Farming:[/b] Slimes in the slime hutch also produce valuable items. When you leave your slimes without water, they'll produce Colored Petrified Slimes or Prismatic Slimes, which are valuable. Requires achieving level 20 in Combat.
[b]Combat-Fishing:[/b] Fish can be used as slingshot ammo. You read it right. Fish on slingshots. The damage the fish will do depends on how expensive it is. Requires achieving level 20 in Combat.
[/spoiler]
[/font][/size][size=4][font=Arial][size=4][font=Arial]
[b]A whole new talent system!
[/b]
Gain and spend points across 6 skill trees with a total of 141 talents, with each of them improving a different aspect of the game. Talent points are gained by levelling skills, completing achievements, completing Qi challenges, and achieving perfection. Once gained, any talent point can be spent in any skill tree. Talent menu can be accessed from the Skills Tab by clicking the skill labels with icons (Such as "Combat ⚔").
New feature of 1.0.1: Clicking already bought talents will disable them.
(Details are in the Talent Details article!)
[/font][/size]
[b]A toggle-able skills overlay to see your status of levels above 10![/b][/font][/size][size=4]
[/size][size=4][img]https://imgur.com/kG37NUf.png[/img]﻿
[b]﻿[/b][color=#f4f4f4][b]*Color Blindness Changes*[/b]
[/color]
[color=#f4f4f4]Changes vanilla and mod's bar icons to striped versions, to help people with color blindness see them! Default false.
(Thanks to Ben the Egg for the suggestion!)

[/color]﻿[color=#f4f4f4][b]*Mastery Cave Changes*
[/b]
[/color]Changes Mastery Cave to be unlocked when you level up skills to levels 20 or 15
instead of 10 and block players from gaining mastery XP and skill maxing achievements until you reach level 20 or 15.
This config doesn't change how you will get mastery XP or skill XP when you unlock the cave.
Valid values are 10, 15 and 20. Default 20.

[b]*Enable Overcrowding Edits*

[/b]Modifies all barn/coop maps to account for their new capacities when Overcrowding talent is obtained.
This can be turned off for compatibility with barn/coop replacer mods.
It's found in the CP part of the mod. Default true.

[b] *Time Changed Updates*
[/b]
If turned on, will attempt to update data assets. If ProfessionsOnly is on, this has no effect. Changes made will require one in-game day to take effect. Can be turned off for performance purposes. It's found in the CP part of the mod. Default true.

[b]*Stamina Cost Adjustments*
[/b]
Changes all vanilla tools (except Milk Pail, Shears and Fishing Rod)
to use some energy when you reach level 20, but it will also cause the tools to cost slightly more energy
than normal if you haven't reached level 20. Default true.

﻿[color=#f4f4f4][b]*Talent Hint Level*
[/b]
[/color]Changes how much of the hints you will see for talents, accepts 'Partial', 'Full' or 'Hidden'.[color=#f4f4f4]
[/color]'Full' shows everything, 'Partial' shows only as far as the talent after the latest unlocked one, 'Hidden' hides everything except those unlocked or bought. Default 'Hidden'.

[b]*Talent Menu Keybinds*[/b]

Allows you to set keybinds to open the talent menu. Added in 1.1.0. Default none.

[b]*Professions Only*

[/b]Turns on and off the talent system. When turned on, talent system will be disabled
and only VPP professions will be functional. Changing the value requires a restart to take effect. Default 'false'.

[b]*Balance Configs*
[/b]
Added in 1.1.0, so that you can set your own balance for your own game. Not everything were added as there's too many to do so. Current adjustables:[i] Cycle of Life, Volatility, Fallout, Crystal Cavern, Upheaval, Aquaculturist, Admiration, Dazzle(in CP part), Wild Growth, Meditation, Down in the Depths and Spawning Season.[/i]

[/size][b][size=4][img]https://imgur.com/ji22rzz.png[/img]

[/size][img]https://imgur.com/fQ0GuFZ.png[/img]
[b][size=5]Overall Compatibility
[/size][/b]
[font=Arial][size=3][b]Mobile[/b]: It's probably incompatible, but I don't own SDV on mobile.
[/size][/font][font=Arial][size=3]
[b]Multiplayer[/b]: Works well outside of some immersion issues. Not a priority.

[b]Split-screen[/b]: Not tested, but there's some work done for it. Not a priority.

[b]Linux/Mac[/b]: Works well on both. Let me know if you encounter issues.

[b]Controller/Gamepad[/b]: Mostly compatible! Let me know if you encounter issues.

[b]Existing Saves[/b]: Get ready for the immersion shatter, nothing should get corrupted or anything though. Run the "vpp.recalculatepoints" to obtain talent points from past levels, achievement and SOs as well as level adjustments.[/size]

[/font][b][size=5]Compatibility with Other Mods
[/size]
[/b][font=Arial][size=3][b]Prestige Mods/All Professions[/b]: VPP's profession code is structured to account for other professions even if you're not supposed to get them in vanilla ways, so if you have a mod that will 'give' them to you in any way it's going to work.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30767][b]Profession Books[/b][/url]﻿ and[b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23697][b]Mastery Extended[/b][/url]﻿ [/b]has built-in compatibility with VPP! (Thank you, Wren and AlanBF!)

[b]SBV(only the base), VMV, WAG and RSV[/b]: Built in compatibility as of 1.1.0

[b]XP Display[/b]: As of 1.1.0, there's built in compatibility! (Thanks to Arshia!)

[b]SpaceCore skills[/b]: The mod will take its skills into account, but[b] I will not add any new content for them.[/b][/size]

[size=3][color=#ffff00][b]MARGO/Walk of Life[/b]: I'm not planning to do anything on my side for it and didn't test if it's compatible, as this is a case of "choose one". The author has officially recommended using this mod until MARGO is completely updated.

[b]SVE:[/b] Unknown. I wont do anything if it's not.

[b]Share Experience[/b]: Half-incompatible. It'll keep taking your "excess XP" and try use it somewhere else, causing you to never reach level 11. There's little I can do since it's not my mod.
[/color]
[b]Any other mod[/b]: It's likely the compatibility is on their side or it doesn't make sense to question whether they work together.

**If you're a mod author who's looking for compatibility or a player who wants to know all the things before throwing the mod in, it's best if you check the mod's [b][url=https://github.com/KediDili/VanillaPlusProfessions][b]GitHub repo[/b][/url]﻿[/b] for documentation.[/size]
[/font][b][size=5][img]https://imgur.com/9oyKMGt.png[/img]﻿[/size][/b]
[b][size=5]Known issues[/size][/b][size=3]
[/size][size=4]
Other than what is written below, if a bug is in the bugs or comments tab, we probably know about it!

[b][i]During spring or fall, you may get errors and be unable to save when you sleep.
[/i][/b]
This is actually caused by an error in daily quest determination logic in vanilla, and CA is aware of it.
As a temporary solution, disable Survival Cooking talent.

It triggers [b]only with VPP[/b] because in vanilla, you will never trigger the bugged part of the logic
since it's locked behind some complex conditions. Survival Cooking recipes are so
simple that they pass the conditions and the bugged logic runs.
As a result, your saving cycle crashes.

~
[/size]
[size=4][b][i]Help! I want to turn off the VPP professions and only use the talent system![/i][/b][/size]

[size=4]This is not possible and we have no plans for it.
[/size]

[size=4][b][i]Help! My XP bar mod isn't showing that I can or already did level up above 10!
[/i][/b][/size]
[size=4]This is a compatibility issue on the other mod's side. The other mod should be updated to account for
VPP's new levels. VPP's API exposes the data for the new levels since 1.0.1.[/size]


[i][size=4][b]Help! I can't see the little plus button on Skills Tab![/b]
[/size][/i]
[size=4]The skills overlay is toggleable only when you have got at least one skill levelled above 10 (level 10 doesn't unlock it, but 11 does) to prevent unnecessary clutter on the menu. If you have any skill above level 10, try resizing your window. If that doesn't work either, submit a bug report with below instructions applied.[/size]


[b][i][size=4]Help! I can't gain any talent points or any levels for vanilla skills despite having enough XP
and[i][size=4] I'm playing on an existing save![/size][/i]
[/size][/i][/b]
[size=4]VPP adds a console command named [font=Courier New]vpp.recalculatepoints
[/font]This adds talent points and adjusts your skill levels depending on your current progress without having to start a new save.
If you had too many XP before installing this mod, your skill levels wont change before you use this command.
This is due to how vanilla skill levelup logic works.


[/size][size=4][b][i]Help! I have way too many talent points because of bugs of the past![/i][/b]

Run the [font=Courier New]vpp.recalculatepoints [/font][/size][size=4]command. If you get a negative number of points, this
just means you used the talent points you gained because of bugs before you ran the command again.
Reset your talent trees to get rid of it.[/size]


[b][i][size=4]Help! I'm level 10 in any/all skill(s) but the Mastery Cave doesn't recognize it!
[/size][/i]
[/b][size=4]VPP changes the skill level limit to 20 instead of 10, so it made sense to change Mastery Cave to be unlocked at level 20 or 15. If you don't want the Mastery Cave to be affected, set the Mastery Cave Changes config to 10.[/size]


[b][size=4][i]Help! I can't access to the Talent Menu![/i]

[/size][/b][size=4]Make sure you have installed the mod properly, that you're clicking the skill labels correctly on skills tab
and that you don't have the Professions Only config turned on.
If none of these don't help, submit a bug report with below instructions applied.[/size]


[size=4][i][b]Help! Sap Sipper/Overcrowding talents aren't working![/b][/i]

Disable them, close the menu, re-enable them, close the menu again and then poof! Magic![/size]
[size=4]If this doesn't help, submit a bug report with below instructions applied.[/size]

[size=4][b][i]Help! I bought "Gift of The Talented" but its stardrop isn't counted in the skills page!
[/i][/b][/size]
[size=4]  This is normal and expected. It's because the game doesn't track how many stardrops you actually ate, it keeps track of the [i]*mail flags*[/i] it gives you while eating them, just to track perfection. The talent's stardrop isn't added because it's not vanilla nor needed for perfection.

[/size]
[size=4][b][i]Help! I don't know how to use Programmable Drill/Thermal Reactor!
I place them and have the materials, but it doesn't work!
[/i][/b][/size]
[size=4]Place the drill in the mine entrance, and the reactor to Caldera. They're designed to work in specific and differn
types of places. The reactor will start working instantly,
the drill will require a battery, any geode/ore/gem/coal/etc. to create more of it.
[/size][size=4][b][i]
Help! Oceanologist is bugged! I can't catch lava eels the first time I reach 80+ floors of mines![/i][/b][/size]
[size=4]  It's not. Oceanologist quits trying to give you a non-trash catch if you're not qualified(Maybe its a legendary you caught before or your fishing level isn't enough for the little pool of fish etc.) for anything at all or if it can't even get one in 100 tries. This is to prevent StackOverflow crashes and profession being OP.
[/size]
[size=4][b][i]Help! I have more than one of Efflorescence, Tropical Bliss and Nourishing Rain but no matter what I do,
they work only once![/i][/b][/size]
[size=4]  Another balance thing. If it were cumulative, it'd be OP.
[/size]
[size=4][b][i]Help! I have a slingshot with Auto-Fire Enchantment, but I can't use Triple Shot with it despite having the talent.[/i][/b][/size]
[size=4]  That one is also for balancing's sake. It'll work fine for slingshots with other enchantments or those without any.[/size]
[b][i]
[size=4]Help! When I use Triple Shot, my character slides if I press move buttons![/size]
[/i][/b]
[size=4]  Feature, not bug. I believed it's a nice thing to be able to move around while aiming,
as flying targets are a pain with slingshots. ^-^
[/size]

[b][i][size=4]Help! Qi Seasoning isn't applied if I have Haute Cuisine enabled![/size]
[/i][/b]
[size=4]  It's something with how it's coded, for some reason, after the talent increases the quality, Qi seasoning just. cancels itself because the food has a non-base quality by the time it looks at it.[/size]


[b][i][size=4]Help! I have got a bug that's none of the above![/size][/i]
[/b]
[size=4]Please send a SMAPI log with [font=Courier New]"harmony_summary","vpp.details"[/font] and [font=Courier New]"patch summary full KediDili.VPPData.CP"[/font] commands ran along with a description and images(if applicable) of the issue. I can't know what's going on in your game without these! Report the bugs to the bugs tab, or they'll be deleted.[/size][/center]
